subtitle: Notes, snippets & quicklinks
promotionalText: Your notes, snippets, quicklinks and calculator from Volant, now on iPhone and iPad. No Volant account. No telemetry.
description: Volant brings the tools you reach for on your Mac to your iPhone and iPad: plain Markdown notes, snippets, quicklinks, and a calculator that understands units, time zones and dates.

Every note is a plain Markdown file in your iCloud Drive, in a Volant folder you can open in Files or Finder. Write in Markdown, then switch to a clean preview with checklists, code blocks and quotes. Pin what matters and search the full text of every note.
WORKS WITH VOLANT ON YOUR MAC
Turn on Sync settings and notes with iCloud in Volant on your Mac, and the same notes, snippets and quicklinks appear here. Edit them on either device.
Copy a snippet with the date, time or your clipboard filled in. Open a quicklink, or type a search straight into one.
A CALCULATOR THAT KNOWS MORE THAN MATH
Units, time zones, dates, percentages, tips, colors and cooking measures, answered as you type.
Search notes, snippets and quicklinks at once, with an answer from the calculator when your search is a calculation.
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for recent notes and quick actions
- A Control Center control that starts a new note
- Save to Volant from the share sheet in any app
- Shortcuts and Siri: create a note, copy a snippet, open a quicklink, calculate
No Volant account. No telemetry. Your notes stay in your own iCloud, and nothing about how you use Volant leaves your devices.
